events.title: COVID Black Thursday crypto crash

research.summary: During the global COVID-19 market panic, Bitcoin fell violently alongside traditional risk assets, dropping below $6,000 and later below $5,000 during the wider selloff.
research.significance: Black Thursday shattered the idea that Bitcoin would automatically behave as a crisis hedge and simultaneously stress-tested DeFi liquidation systems.

events.title: DeFi Summer

research.summary: DeFi Summer describes the rapid 2020 expansion of decentralized lending, automated market makers, liquidity mining and yield farming after COMP distribution.
research.significance: It is a major historical era node connecting Compound, Curve, Yearn, SushiSwap, Uniswap and many copycat protocols rather than one single event.

events.title: SushiSwap vampire attack

research.summary: SushiSwap launched as a Uniswap fork with SUSHI liquidity-mining incentives and then migrated more than $800 million of liquidity away from Uniswap in a 'vampire attack.'
research.significance: The episode became a defining demonstration of permissionless forks, liquidity incentives and community-owned protocol competition.

events.title: MicroStrategy adopts a Bitcoin treasury strategy

research.summary: MicroStrategy announced it had purchased 21,454 BTC for $250 million and adopted Bitcoin as its primary treasury reserve asset.
research.significance: The move created the modern corporate Bitcoin treasury playbook and turned a public operating company into a leveraged proxy for Bitcoin exposure.

sources.title: SEC filing — MicroStrategy adopts Bitcoin treasury reserve

events.title: Third Bitcoin halving

research.summary: At block 630,000, Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 12.5 BTC to 6.25 BTC.
research.significance: The third halving reinforced Bitcoin's programmed scarcity just months before the institutional treasury-adoption wave.

events.title: Compound launches COMP liquidity mining

research.summary: Compound began distributing COMP governance tokens to protocol users who supplied or borrowed assets.
research.significance: The distribution ignited the liquidity-mining and yield-farming boom that defined DeFi Summer.

events.title: YFI and Yearn become emblematic of DeFi Summer

research.summary: Andre Cronje launched the YFI governance token with no pre-mine, investor sale or founder allocation, distributing the initial 30,000 tokens through liquidity provision.
research.significance: YFI became the defining 'fair launch' of DeFi Summer and helped turn yield optimization into a community-governed movement.

events.title: Uniswap distributes UNI in a landmark airdrop

research.summary: Uniswap launched the UNI governance token and allocated 15% of the genesis supply for immediate distribution to historical users and liquidity providers.
research.significance: The airdrop became the canonical retroactive token distribution and reset competitive dynamics after SushiSwap's attack.

events.title: PayPal announces cryptocurrency support

research.summary: PayPal announced a service allowing US users to buy, hold and sell Bitcoin, Ether, Bitcoin Cash and Litecoin, with plans to use crypto as a funding source at merchants.
research.significance: PayPal brought direct crypto access to a vast mainstream payments user base and signaled a major fintech shift toward digital assets.

events.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain launches

research.summary: Ethereum's Beacon Chain produced its genesis block on 1 December 2020 and began running proof-of-stake consensus alongside the existing proof-of-work chain.
research.significance: The Beacon Chain was the decisive live precursor to Ethereum's 2022 Merge.

events.title: US authorities bring major enforcement action against BitMEX

research.summary: The CFTC sued BitMEX entities and founders over alleged unregistered derivatives operations and AML failures, while US prosecutors separately charged four executives with Bank Secrecy Act offenses.
research.significance: The coordinated action was a watershed enforcement event for offshore crypto derivatives platforms.

events.title: Bahamas launches the Sand Dollar CBDC

research.summary: The Central Bank of The Bahamas began national rollout of the Sand Dollar, a digital version of the Bahamian dollar.
research.significance: The Sand Dollar became the first widely recognized fully deployed central-bank digital currency at national scale.

sources.title: Central Bank of Bahamas — Sand Dollar rollout

events.title: Shenzhen runs a major public digital-yuan pilot

research.summary: Shenzhen ran a large public digital-renminbi pilot, distributing 10 million yuan through 50,000 digital red envelopes usable at designated merchants; official results reported 47,573 recipients and 62,788 transactions during the test window.
research.significance: The Shenzhen trial was one of the clearest early public demonstrations of China's central-bank digital currency at consumer scale.

sources.title: Shenzhen Government — digital RMB red-envelope pilot
Shenzhen Government — digital RMB pilot results

events.title: Flash-loan attacks expose new DeFi security risks

research.summary: The bZx attacks and later incidents made flash-loan-assisted attacks a recurring DeFi security topic.
research.significance: This is a broader security trend best represented by specific exploit events rather than scored independently.

events.title: US government seizes a large cache of Silk Road-linked Bitcoin

research.summary: US authorities seized approximately 69,370 BTC linked to funds stolen from Silk Road and filed a civil forfeiture complaint days later.
research.significance: At the time it was the largest cryptocurrency seizure announced by the US Department of Justice and added a huge new government Bitcoin holding.

sources.title: DOJ — November 2020 Silk Road-linked Bitcoin seizure

events.title: Solana mainnet beta launches

research.summary: Solana initialized its Mainnet Beta with a global validator community in March 2020.
research.significance: Solana introduced a high-throughput alternative smart-contract architecture that later became one of the largest non-Ethereum crypto ecosystems.

events.title: Avalanche mainnet launches

research.summary: Avalanche launched its mainnet in September 2020.
research.significance: Avalanche became a major smart-contract and subnet ecosystem built around the Avalanche consensus family.

events.title: Curve launches stablecoin-focused AMM

research.summary: Curve launched in early 2020 as an automated market maker optimized for efficient trading between stablecoins.
research.significance: Its specialized invariant made stablecoin swaps cheaper and less price-sensitive and established Curve as core DeFi liquidity infrastructure.

sources.title: Curve — The Rise of the Home of Stablecoins

events.title: Aave becomes a major decentralized lending protocol

research.summary: Aave V1 launched in January 2020 after the ETHLend team rebuilt its peer-to-peer lending model around pooled liquidity.
research.significance: Aave became one of DeFi's dominant lending protocols and helped popularize flash loans and pooled money markets.

sources.title: Aave Labs — historical contributions / Aave V1

events.title: Yam Finance rapid rise and bug become DeFi Summer lore

research.summary: Yam Finance launched after roughly ten days of development, rapidly attracted hundreds of millions of dollars of staked assets and then disclosed a critical rebase/governance bug.
research.significance: YAM became the perfect symbol of DeFi Summer's speed, experimental 'food token' culture and smart-contract risk.

events.title: Flashbots forms to address MEV and transaction-ordering issues

research.summary: Flashbots emerged in 2020 to address miner/maximal extractable value; its initial architecture and MEV-geth work were made public in November before the later Flashbots Alpha launch.
research.significance: Flashbots turned MEV from a largely hidden transaction-ordering problem into an explicit research and infrastructure field for Ethereum.

events.title: MakerDAO Black Thursday produces emergency governance

research.summary: MakerDAO suffered severe liquidation stress during Black Thursday as collateral prices collapsed and congestion impaired keepers, producing zero-bid auctions and protocol bad debt.
research.significance: The crisis became DeFi's first major systemic stress test and forced emergency governance, risk changes and new collateral choices.

events.title: Uniswap V2 launches

research.summary: Uniswap v2 deployed to Ethereum mainnet with arbitrary ERC-20/ERC-20 pairs, flash swaps and improved oracle functionality.
research.significance: V2 turned Uniswap from an elegant proof of concept into a major decentralized exchange and the platform targeted by SushiSwap's vampire attack.

events.title: Square purchases Bitcoin for its corporate treasury

research.summary: Square announced the purchase of approximately 4,709 BTC for $50 million, about 1% of its assets at the time.
research.significance: Square's purchase reinforced the emerging idea that public technology companies could hold Bitcoin on their balance sheets.

events.title: Binance Smart Chain launches

research.summary: Binance Smart Chain launched mainnet as an EVM-compatible blockchain using BNB for fees and staking.
research.significance: BSC created a low-cost smart-contract ecosystem closely linked to Binance and became a major venue for retail DeFi activity in 2021.

sources.title: Binance — Binance Smart Chain Mainnet Launch
BNB Chain — Binance Smart Chain Mainnet Launch

events.title: Telegram abandons original TON project after SEC court battle

research.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov announced that Telegram was ending its involvement in the original TON blockchain after a US court blocked the planned Gram distribution.
research.significance: The shutdown showed that even a globally distributed technology project backed by a huge private token raise could be stopped by securities enforcement.

sources.title: Pavel Durov — What Was TON And Why It Is Over

events.title: Art Blocks launches generative on-chain art platform

research.summary: Art Blocks launched with Snowfro's Chromie Squiggle collection on 27 November 2020.
research.significance: Art Blocks established a platform for generative art created and minted on-chain and became one of the defining institutions of the NFT art movement.

events.title: US OCC allows national banks to provide crypto custody services

research.summary: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency clarified that national banks and federal savings associations may provide cryptocurrency custody services.
research.significance: The interpretation opened a formal route for federally chartered banks to hold cryptographic keys and offer crypto custody.

sources.title: OCC — national banks may provide crypto custody

events.title: India Supreme Court overturns central-bank crypto banking restriction

research.summary: India's Supreme Court set aside the RBI's 2018 circular that had prohibited regulated entities from providing banking services to crypto businesses.
research.significance: The decision reopened banking access to India's crypto sector and became a landmark judicial check on a central-bank restriction.

sources.title: Supreme Court of India — IAMAI v RBI judgment

events.title: Swiss Parliament passes DLT blanket act

research.summary: The Swiss Parliament passed the federal DLT blanket act in September 2020, establishing legal changes for ledger-based securities, trading facilities and insolvency treatment.
research.significance: The legislation created one of the world's clearest national legal frameworks for tokenized assets and distributed-ledger financial infrastructure.

sources.title: Swiss Federal Council — DLT legislative framework

research.significance: The recovery is useful aftermath showing the exchange's return to normal operations, but it is subordinate to the hack itself.

sources.title: KuCoin — Deposit and Withdrawal Services Resumed

events.title: KuCoin suffers a major exchange hack

research.summary: KuCoin disclosed a security incident in which private keys to hot wallets were compromised and crypto assets were transferred out without authorization.
research.significance: The hack became one of 2020's largest centralized-exchange thefts and a major case study in recovery, token freezes and exchange coordination.

events.title: The Graph mainnet launches decentralized indexing network

research.summary: The Graph launched its decentralized indexing network mainnet.
research.significance: The Graph became core data-query infrastructure for decentralized applications and a major piece of Web3's middleware stack.

events.title: Filecoin mainnet launches decentralized storage market

research.summary: Filecoin mainnet went live around 15:00 UTC on 15 October 2020.
research.significance: Filecoin created a live token-incentivized decentralized storage marketplace after one of the ICO era's largest fundraises.

events.title: THORChain begins cross-chain liquidity development

research.summary: THORChain released a public testnet in June 2020 and launched BEPSwap on Chaosnet in September, but its true multichain Chaosnet launch followed in April 2021.
research.significance: 2020 was an important precursor year for THORChain rather than the canonical live multichain launch.
research.notes: Do not describe THORChain's multichain network as live in 2020.

events.title: Polkadot mainnet launch establishes relay-chain architecture

research.summary: Web3 Foundation launched the initial version of Polkadot on 26 May 2020.
research.significance: Polkadot became a major multi-chain architecture built around shared security and interoperability.
